verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is API/code-first by design: the Python AsyncWebCrawler API, REST server (crwl4ai-gh-23), CLI (crawl4ai-gh-2, probe-4), and MCP integration (gh-22, probe-3) expose essentially all crawling, extraction, and session features. The only 'UI' elements are a lightweight playground for generating request code (gh-21) and a monitoring dashboard (gh-6), both auxiliary to—not exclusive of—the API/CLI paths.
